reason: Yes on the narrow definitional fix only. The revision expressly amends Act 21 ss1-5, mechanically defines base/direct-child candidate/direct-child carrier/single fast-forward, states timestamps are chronology not execution proof, and adds ten fail-closed fixtures. It preserves exact-candidate verification and does not claim to restore the 99% compliance rate (that is Executive checker work under Act 26). Residual O5/B5 is a cost/benefit judgment; I judge the textual ambiguity durable enough to warrant this clarifying law. Both red-teams are byte-exact in s8a/s8b.
